effect.name: Shadert0y
effect.description: Runs a Shadertoy GLSL script offscreen via OpenGL, with internal render resolution and basic buffer-script support.
effect.author: HyperDev

parameter.name: Script File
parameter.comment: Select the main .glsl or .frag file. If empty, a default color shader is used.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.comment: Time multiplier. Negative values reverse time.

parameter.name: File 0
parameter.comment: Image file or basic .glsl buffer script used when an iChannel is set to File 0.

parameter.name: File 1
parameter.comment: Image file or basic .glsl buffer script used when an iChannel is set to File 1.

parameter.name: File 2
parameter.comment: Image file or basic .glsl buffer script used when an iChannel is set to File 2.

parameter.name: Render Width
parameter.comment: Internal shader render width. 0 = use incoming frame size. Set to project width to render at project resolution and scale to preview/output.

parameter.name: Render Height
parameter.comment: Internal shader render height. 0 = use incoming frame size. Set to project height to render at project resolution and scale to preview/output.
